articles.title: Turning a Cheap Android Photo Frame into an Ambient Family Dashboard
articles.excerpt: Inspired by Wes Bos's writeup on hacking smart photo frames, I set out to build an ambient, wall-mounted dashboard for our household. Instead of buying dedicated smart display hardware, I went looking…
articles.body: Inspired by Wes Bos's writeup on hacking smart photo frames , I set out to build an ambient, wall-mounted dashboard for our household. Instead of buying dedicated smart display hardware, I went looking for the cheapest digital photo frame I could find. I ended up with a generic 10.1" digital photo frame running Frameo. Most of these budget devices are full Android tablets underneath the plastic, but out of the box, the vendor firmware locks them down strictly to a photo-sharing carousel. This article documents how I repurposed this device into an always-on family dashboard: uncovering root access via ADB, debloating the vendor software, solving the limitations of an ancient Android 6 WebView, and deploying a modern full-stack web app on Cloudflare Workers. 1.
articles.author: Vitor Ferreira

articles.title: 10 n8n Workflows Every Small Business Should Automate
articles.excerpt: Small businesses don't have an automation problem — they have a "death by a thousand copy-pastes" problem. Leads sit in inboxes for hours. Invoices get chased by hand. The same report gets rebuilt eve…
articles.body: Small businesses don't have an automation problem — they have a "death by a thousand copy-pastes" problem. Leads sit in inboxes for hours. Invoices get chased by hand. The same report gets rebuilt every Monday morning. n8n fixes this without the per-task pricing of Zapier or the lock-in of proprietary platforms. It's fair-code, self-hostable, and its Code node means you never hit the "the visual builder can't do this" wall. Here are the ten highest-ROI workflows I deploy for small businesses, each with its actual architecture. 1. Instant Lead Notifications Problem: Form submissions sit unread for hours; speed-to-lead decides who wins the deal.

articles.body: Every list of "best social media tools" already has twenty entries. If you are building alone, entering that market needs a better reason than "mine will be nicer". This is the reason I settled on, and the first part of a series where I go through Clienzo one piece at a time. Who it is for I did not want to build for marketing teams with approval chains. Clienzo is for people who post for themselves or a handful of clients: a founder announcing a launch, a freelancer running three clients' accounts, a small agency that wants each client kept separate. Those people have one thing in common. Posting is not their job. It is the thing between them and their actual job. The narrow bet Most schedulers are built around their own composer. You open the app, write, pick accounts, schedule.

articles.body: Forward Deployed Engineer challenge: I built a company ERP portal in 2 days with AI A company posted a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) job ad with a take-home brief: build an internal operations portal in three working days. articles.body: Next.js basePath 404 Nginx: Running Two Next.js Apps on One Domain If you've ever hit a Next.js basePath 404 behind Nginx, you already know the feeling: the HTML loads, the page looks half-alive, and every script and stylesheet comes back 404. articles.title: How to Mail Merge from Excel (.xlsx / CSV) into Official IRS & ACA PDFs (1095-C, W-9, Form 2848, SS-4) Without Adobe Acrobat
articles.excerpt: Every January through March, engineering teams, payroll ops, and accounting practices hit the same wall: a spreadsheet with 50 to 500 rows of employee or entity records in .xlsx or .csv format, and an…
articles.body: Every January through March, engineering teams, payroll ops, and accounting practices hit the same wall: a spreadsheet with 50 to 500 rows of employee or entity records in .xlsx or .csv format, and an official IRS PDF template ( f1095c.pdf , fw9.pdf , f2848.pdf , fss4.pdf , or f843.pdf ) that needs one populated PDF generated per row. If you open an official IRS PDF in a standard Python script and try to map column employee_ssn to a field named "employee_ssn" , zero fields match. Even worse, if you guess the field name and write {"c1_1[0]": "Yes"} to a checkbox, the generated PDF opens in macOS Preview or Chrome with an unchecked box.

articles.title: Why Exporting Word (.docx) to PDF Strips Form Fields (And How AcroForm Widget Reconstruction Works)
articles.excerpt: If you build an intake form, contract template, or HR onboarding sheet in Microsoft Word using Developer → Content Controls (Plain Text, Check Box, Combo Box, or Date Picker) and export it via File →…
articles.body: If you build an intake form, contract template, or HR onboarding sheet in Microsoft Word using Developer → Content Controls (Plain Text, Check Box, Combo Box, or Date Picker) and export it via File → Save As → PDF or Microsoft Print to PDF , the resulting PDF looks right on screen—until someone tries to type into it. Every text box, checkbox, and underline is dead geometry. If you inspect the PDF's root /Catalog dictionary, /AcroForm is completely absent.

articles.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
articles.excerpt: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attac…
articles.body: Expect to see quite a few websites serving error pages today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild. Image: Shutterstock.com, Sashkin. The flaws at issue are present in PHP , the programming language that powers sites running on a large number of web publishing systems, including Drupal , Magento , Joomla and WordPress . Earlier today, PHP released an emergency security update to fix two critical bugs that can allow an attacker to execute code of their choosing on a vulnerable server.
